name: zeffect_anim_get_activation_record_packed_size
description: zEffect_Anim::GetActivationRecordPackedSize returns the serialized prefix length for each activation-record command type.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Final byte matching should be handled with the coherent zEffect animation source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x461800 validates commandType switch values returning 0x38 for type 1, 0x48 for type 2, 0x4c for type 3, and 0x50 for type 4 or any other/default command type.
The native activation-record queue smoke verifies packed-size behavior for queued type-2 records and covers the activation-record serialization contract used by packet forwarding.
